title: Wait without becoming inert
situation: Waiting at a closed door: shifts of weight, a look at the door, a look at the watch, a sigh. She gives up, turns and goes; a voice comes from behind the door; she stops mid-stride, the head turns first, then the body, and she comes back.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
